`init.lua` is editor configuration, not portable AI context; its effective location can vary with XDG/NVIM_APPNAME. Native Neovim has no Skills, rules, prompts, MCP, or project-config mapping. Plugins are separate products, and any migration to Lua must be manual.

Sources: [startup](https://neovim.io/doc/user/starting/), [Lua](https://neovim.io/doc/user/lua-guide/).
